# Independent seed pair with primitive context

Two independent Object-bounded method seeds retain both invariant Map.Entry
result slots beside an original boolean context. The provider constructs a
mutable or immutable entry, exposes its exact fields to a callback, and returns
an independently supplied object. Four frozen routes compare 96 cases twice
for source and SDK providers, compiling all output and auditing all original
entries and metadata. Null/raw values, allocation class and identity, mutability,
partial effects, exact failures and late casts remain observable. Six wrong
programs and six Code-preserving Signature controls guard the proof.
Only authored fixtures execute.
